about_the_game:
"What do I look like?"

On my way home from overtime, a dark figure suddenly appeared before me.

Faced with the figure's question, and looking at the twintails on her head, longer than my arms, I fell silent...

-----------------------------

"Cantonese Twintails' Repay of a Favor" is a youth romance galgame, a visual novel. Players can click on the screen to read the dialogue and story text.

This game is single-character, single-ending, and contains no choice branches. The total playtime is approximately 2.5 hours.

The game features four beautiful, independent animated CGs.

The female protagonist is fully voiced.

-----------------------------

Note: This game is a galgame (AVG - text game). It does not contain any other gameplay or systems. Just like reading a novel, you can only click on the screen and read text.

Note 2: All characters in the game are adults. The characters, stories, locations, plots, and world depicted are all fictional and have no connection to any real-life people or events.
